headline: Approved $240000 transfer to pay CLA for audit support and a finance organizational study.
summary: Director Hul said the transfer covers a $50K finance organizational study and audit support for July through December 2026. Chair Alston pulled a $70,000 request for a special education system review after earlier discussions.
decisions: Approved the $240000 interdepartmental transfer for payment to CLA, unanimously, with 0 opposed and 0 abstentions.
Pulled from the agenda the $70,000 request for a special education system review.

1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL Opened at 10:55pm 
Finance Committee Meeting Minutes, October 5, 2026 – 7:00pm.  Chair Alston called the 
meeting to order at 10:55pm with the members noted above in attendance.  
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No members of the public came forward for Public Input.  
  
 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Chair Alston noted the upcoming Finance Commission meeting and that year-to-date 
reports were attached for the departments noted below.

Town State of Connecticut Monthly Update 
  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. MOTION TO ACCEPT REFERRALS TO THE FINANCE COMMITTEE 
ORDER AUTHORIZING INTERDEPARTMENTAL TRANSFER 2026 - 2027 FISCAL 
YEAR BUDGET - FINANCE DEPARTMENT 
MOTION: Gallagher 
SECOND: Alston
Director Hul explained the transfer was for $240000 for payment to CLA.  He noted 
that $50K was to cover the finance organizational study which was getting underway 
while the balance was for audit support for the period July-December 2026.  
 
VOTE: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 1 passed unanimously.  
  2. MOTION TO ACCEPT REFERRALS TO THE FINANCE COMMITTEE 
ADDITIONAL FUNDING REQUEST OF AN ALLOCATION IN THE AMOUNT OF 
$70,000 FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION SYSTEM REVIEW – Item pulled. 
Based on discussions that took place earlier in the evening, Chair Alston said that he 
was pulling this item. 
  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting.  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting.  
7. ADJOURN 
Chair Alston reiterated that Boards, Commission information was posted.  With no 
additional business before the committee, Chair Alston adjourned the meeting at 
11:06pm.
